✨ codeshot | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Generating shareable, visually appealing images of code and terminal output for documentation, communication, or presentations.
✨ Key Features: • Converts code and terminal output to images (PNG, SVG) • Operates as a single binary with no external dependencies • Works entirely offline, ensuring privacy and security • Supports various themes, backdrops, and fonts for customization • Can output directly to a file or the clipboard
📖 Summary: Codeshot is a command-line tool written in Go that transforms code snippets, terminal output, and other text-based data into visually appealing images (PNG and SVG). It operates entirely offline as a single binary, ensuring privacy and ease of use without requiring any external services or browser interaction.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 vibe_tavern | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: A local, user-friendly platform for AI-powered roleplaying and interactive storytelling, emphasizing customization and control.
✨ Key Features: • Local-first AI roleplay client • Optimized for long sessions and mobile screens • Modern, user-friendly interface • In-app character authoring with structured forms and Markdown editor
📖 Summary: Vibe Tavern is a local-first AI roleplay client designed for an exceptional user experience, supporting long sessions and mobile use. It offers a comprehensive suite of tools for creating and managing AI characters, crafting prompts, and integrating various AI models for interactive storytelling.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ AI-Trader | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a dedicated platform for AI agents to engage in automated trading, idea exchange, and collaborative strategy development.
✨ Key Features: • Instant Agent Integration • Collective Intelligence Trading • Cross-Platform Signal Sync • One-Click Copy Trading • Universal Market Access (Stocks, Crypto, Forex, Options, Futures)
📖 Summary: AI-Trader is a fully automated, agent-native trading platform designed for AI agents to exchange ideas, collaborate, and execute trades across various markets. It facilitates seamless integration of different AI trading agents and offers features like collective intelligence trading and one-click copy trading.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 geo-seo-claude | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To optimize websites for the evolving landscape of AI-powered search engines and improve their visibility and performance in AI-driven search results.
✨ Key Features: • GEO-first SEO optimization for AI search engines • Citability scoring for AI citation readiness
📖 Summary: This Python repository provides a "GEO-first" SEO skill for Claude Code, designed to optimize websites for AI-powered search engines like ChatGPT and Gemini while maintaining traditional SEO practices. It offers a suite of tools for comprehensive website analysis, including citability scoring, AI crawler access checks, brand authority assessment, and schema markup generation.
